intro: Cameroon has a varied economy of oil, timber, cocoa and coffee.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Oil, timber, cocoa, coffee, bananas and cotton are exported. Douala's port serves Chad and the Central African Republic.

chapters.title: Farming
text: Most people farm, growing plantains, cassava and maize.

cardGroups.title: Made in Cameroon
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Cameroon makes and sells to the world.
